maddeler.e:
نتزلزل (form IIq)
# نَتَزَلْزَلُ (natazalzalu) /na.ta.zal.za.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَزَلْزَلَ (tazalzala)
# نَتَزَلْزَلَ (natazalzala) /na.ta.zal.za.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَزَلْزَلَ (tazalzala)
# نَتَزَلْزَلْ (natazalzal) /na.ta.zal.zal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَزَلْزَلَ (tazalzala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
